name: EURUSD M1 Candidate K 30 USD Capital Profit Guard
intent: Validate Candidate J on a 30 USD small-account profile with stricter capital protection, profit lock behavior, and no leverage/risk escalation.
important_note: No trading system is literally perfect. This preset defines the strongest practical protection layer available in the current bot without adding unsafe recovery logic.
safety_exclusions: No aggressive Candidate E TP/SL profile

capital_profile.broker_min_volume_rule: If the broker minimum volume prevents risk from staying inside the cap, the cBot should skip the trade instead of oversizing.

position_level: Mandatory SL/TP on every market order
account_level: No position stacking or recovery sizing
profit_protection: Daily profit target locks the day after profit target is hit
Breakeven protects winning trades from reverting into full losses
Adverse delta exit closes when order-flow proxy flips strongly against the position
Shortened 14:00-14:54 UTC session avoids the negative tail identified after Candidate I

validation_plan: Run 2024-09-09 to 2026-09-09 2Y EURUSD M1 validation with 30 USD balance.
Compare against Candidate J 100 USD result: return 73.42%, PF 1.4423, max drawdown 9.73%.
Promote only if the small-account test remains profitable and does not breach the drawdown/risk envelope.
